build.//development: The build you install once and then never rebuild unless a native dependency changes. It contains expo-dev-client rather than a bundle, so it loads JS from Metro over the network and every code change is a reload. `internal` distribution means it installs by link or QR instead of going through a store; on Android that needs an APK, because an AAB is a store upload format and not something a phone can install.
build.//preview: A self-contained build with the JS baked in: no Metro, no laptop. What to hand someone who just wants to use it.
